content:
maya: FYI we're doing a supply-chain keystore + image-provenance sweep today 11:00 PT. Need RBAC review for signer role, KMS alias rotation dry-run, and audit-forwarding smoke. Trace id=sc-4312345678. Who can take what? :eyes:
jon: I can own RBAC preflight. Which service accounts change?
maya: signer-sa, runtime-host, deploy-bot. Plan: restrict signer-sa to "sign:images" and read-only list on registry. Drop broad repo scopes.
sam: I'll run KMS wrap/unwrap dry-run in staging and cosign verify. Will push wrapped key to staging alias sc-signer-staging.
irene: I'll validate audit-forwarding to Splunk + SIEM. I'll grep for trace id sc-4312345678 and check fields: request.user, pod.name, image.digest, cosign.attestation.id.
sec-bot: automated: created ticket SEC-9012 and runbook https://redwood-internal/runbooks/supplychain-keystore-preflight
jon: RBAC preflight commands I plan to run:```sh
kubectl get rolebinding signer-sa-binding -n images -o yaml
kubectl auth can-i --as=system:serviceaccount:images:signer-sa sign images
```
sam: KMS dry-run steps: 1) create ephemeral wrapping key in staging 2) envelope-wrap cosign private key 3) push wrapped blob to secret store 4) cosign sign & verify. Verify cmd:```sh
COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 cosign verify --key k8s://secret/keystore/staging/sc-signer-pub.pem ghcr.io/redwood/prod-image:canary
```
irene: Audit checks: ensure request.user shows system:serviceaccount:images:signer-sa, attestation present, responseStatus 200, and event.timestamp within +/-5s of deploy.
(5m later) sam: staging KMS dry-run OK: wrapped key created, cosign verify returns OK. Snippet: "Verification for ghcr.io/redwood/prod-image:canary -- OK"
jon: RBAC canary: initial role removed cluster-level list; e2e hit an access denied when signer tried to list repo tags. Adjusted role to allow registry:ListObjects on specific prefix; re-tested, sign succeed.
irene: Staging audit-forwarding: found events with trace sc-4312345678. Sample fields: request.user=system:serviceaccount:images:signer-sa, image.digest=sha256:abcd..., cosign.attestation=true.
maya: Good. Next steps: schedule prod swap at 11:00 with canary gating at 11:10. Sam, push wrapped key to prod keystore alias sc-signer-prod after canary green. Jon, patch RBAC in prod; Irene, watch audit sink. Ops, you monitor.
ops-oncall: Monitoring window 11:00-12:00 PT. I'll open #incident if error rate >2x baseline or sign failures >0.5%.
sam: Prod wrap plan: create new alias sc-signer-prod-v2, push wrapped key, update signer-sa secret pointer, run cosign verify, then rotate alias to v2. Backup previous alias as sc-signer-prod-v1.
jon: Will apply RBAC change with automation and include a TTL rollback job to revoke in 15m if issues.
irene: I'll post a sanitized sample event 2m post-canary.
(After canary) irene: Canary audit check: events ingested, attestation present, request.user correct, no duplicate events.
sam: Pushed wrapped key to prod alias sc-signer-prod-v2 and ran cosign verify: OK.
jon: RBAC applied in prod, signer signs succeeded. No access denied seen.
maya: Excellent. Closing run: 1) keep keystore backups for 24h 2) run full vuln-scan on signer image tomorrow 3) update release notes with RBAC change and runbook link. Thanks team. :heart:
